description: [S7.12] Roadmap decision G15 says the stock install has `sounds\Golf_Sfx`. The CD's InstallShield header iso\data1.hdr names the directory `Golf Sfx` (one occurrence, file offset 586212; no `Golf_Sfx`), and unshield's extraction (extracted\cab, copied to original\) wrote it as `Golf_Sfx`, as it wrote `Program_Files_(ENGLISH)` and `Desert_Music`. On an NTFS install with `Golf Sfx` the exe's `sounds\Golf sfx\` names (0x004d1da0 .. 0x004d2020, 0x004d104c) match case-insensitively and the original plays them; the failed opens belong to the extracted install (the one the LAN build stages). No InstallShield install of the CD was run.
path to resolution: install the CD with its own setup in a scratch VM and list sounds\; if it holds `Golf Sfx`, the switch only matters for extracted installs and its decision row should say so (D54 already states it)

description: [S7.12] Other exe sound names absent from original\ (log/roadmap/S7/12_absent_names.log, 152 `sounds\...` names in golf_clean.exe, 13 absent at switch 0): six music names under `sounds\music\Desert Music\`, `Links Music\`, `Tropical Music\` (Spanish Guitar 1 / 3, Bagpipe2, Harpiscord 1, Steel Drum 1a, Steel Drums 3) whose files exist under `Desert_Music` / `Links_Music` / `Tropical_Music`: the same unshield space-to-underscore rename as Golf_Sfx (the CD header names `Desert Music`, `Tropical Music`, `Links Music`). path to resolution: the lead / Mariano decide whether the music directories get the same alias (a second switch or a wider sound.golfSfxAlias); the seven CD-level mismatches are the stock game's own data S7.13 (decision G16, 2026-10-30): sound.golfSfxAlias 0 also opens the six music names from the underscore directories (port/src/sim/audio_exe.cpp kDirAliases; port/test/test_defects_golfsfx.py MUSIC); the seven CD names stay absent.
status: resolved (music: S7.13); the seven CD names kept as the original
